tools.description: Whether the engine takes a job document, and its refusals when it does not. Nothing runs.

inputSchema.description:
A job as a client hands it to the node: the job document, as version 1 JSON (`v1`) or as
version 2's FlatBuffers in base64 (`v2`), exactly one of the two, and the secrets its
object-store settings refer to by name (`{"secret": "<name>"}`).

secrets.description:
The job's secrets (object-store credentials), by name: at most 32. They reach the engine
beside the document, never in it, and the node shows none of them in any answer, event,
log or report of this job.

v1.description: The job document, version 1, as JSON.

v2.description: The job document, version 2: its `MJB2` FlatBuffer in standard base64.

inputSchema.title: Job

items.description: One refusal of a job document, with the field it is about.

field.description:

as a whole.

message.description: One sentence that says what to change.

outputSchema.title: Validation

tools.description: A job's events, a page at a time: up to 1,000, and 1 MiB of them, after the record `from` (0, or absent, for the first), each event and log record with its number, then, once every record has been given and the job has ended, its report and its exit. `next` is the `from` of the next call: poll with it until the exit.

from.description: The number of the last record already read, as Server-Sent Events' Last-Event-ID: the records after it are sent. 0, or absent, for the first.

tools.name: moruna_jobs_events

outputSchema.description:
The answer of the MCP tool `moruna_jobs_events`: a page of a job's events, as a stream of
`GET /v1/jobs/{id}/events` after the record `from` would send them at once, and where the
next page begins.

next.description:
The `from` of the next call: the number of the last record in this page, or this call's
`from` when the page holds none.

records.description:
At most 1,000, and at most 1 MiB of JSON unless the first alone is larger, in the order
the stream sends them: the job's event and log records after `from`, then, once they
have all been given, a note of the engine's skipped lines if it had any, and, once the
job has ended, its report and its exit, which come together.

items.description: One event of a job's stream, as `GET /v1/jobs/{id}/events` sends it.

data.description: Its JSON: the record's line as `moruna_event` renders it, or the engine's message.

oneOf.description: An event or log record of the engine's.
How many of the engine's lines were too long to read, and were skipped.
The engine's `report` message: the run's report and its plan.
The engine's `exit` message: its exit code and diagnostic. Nothing follows it.

id.description: The record's number in the job's stream, from 1, for an `event`; absent for the others.

outputSchema.title: JobEvents

tools.description: A job's report, the engine's RunReport, once the job has ended.
tools.name: moruna_jobs_report

tools.description: Register a function image by name: its https:// address, its SHA-256, and an Ed25519 signature over that SHA-256 by one of node config's functions.keys. Nothing is fetched until a job names it; registering a name again replaces it.

inputSchema.description:
A function image to register, the body of `POST /v1/functions` (system design 3E). Unknown
fields are refused.

address.description:
Where the image file is fetched from at job start: an `https://` URL. An object store's
private object is given as a pre-signed or SAS URL.

name.description:
The name a job names the function by (a version 1 `kernels` entry
`{"kind": "function", "function": "<name>"}`, a version 2 task of kind `function`): 1 to 64
characters, a lowercase letter first, then lowercase letters, digits, `_`, `-` and `.`.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the image file, as 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

signature.description:
An Ed25519 signature over the 32 bytes of that SHA-256, by one of node config's
`functions.keys`, in standard base64.

inputSchema.title: FunctionRegistration

tools.name: moruna_functions_register

outputSchema.description: A registered function, as `GET /v1/functions` lists it.

address.description: Where its image is fetched from.

key.description:
The first 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the public bytes of the key whose signature
verified, as the audit record names a token key.

name.description: The name a job names it by.

registered.description: When it was registered, in Unix seconds.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of its image, as 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.
